svg.title: TGE Scan data flow
svg.desc: Complete data lifecycle from user scan through API validation to priority classification and queue persistence. Shows offline handling, sync on reconnect, and real-time priority updates.

g.text: 1. User scans barcode in React UI
Barcode → manifest ID + item data extracted
Check manifest exists | Item matches | Quantity valid
Instant local write | Optimistic UI update
If offline: mark for background sync | If online: queue immediately
Check for conflicts (item already scanned elsewhere)
WebSocket: broadcast tier update to allocation view
Item queued by tier | Awaiting allocation engine
